'''Subash Chandar K''' (born {{Birth based on age as of date|41|2023|October|noage=yes}}<ref name=":2">{{Cite news |date=8 October 2023 |title=From New Zealand to India, a maths teacher helps students crack entrance exams — using YouTube |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/kolkata/new-zealand-to-india-maths-teacher-entrance-exams-youtube-8967965/ |access-date=21 March 2025 |work=[[The Indian Express]]}}</ref>) is an Indian-New Zealand mathematics teacher in [[Auckland]]. He runs a [[YouTube]] channel named '''infinityplusone''', where he teaches secondary school students and prepares them for [[NCEA (New Zealand)|NCEA]] exams. In 2025 Chandar K was awarded the Local Hero of the Year award at the [[New Zealander of the Year Awards]].

== Biography ==
Chandar K moved from [[Chennai]], India, to New Zealand aged 12. His mother was a maths professor in Chennai.<ref name=":2" /> As of 2025, Chandar K lives in [[Auckland]] and teaches at [[Ormiston Junior College]] in [[Flat Bush]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite news |date=21 March 2025 |title=Maths teacher, Local Hero of the Year winner's message to students and parents |url=https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/national/545539/maths-teacher-local-hero-of-the-year-winner-s-message-to-students-and-parents |access-date=21 March 2025 |work=[[RNZ]]}}</ref>

His YouTube channel infinityplusone has 70,700 subscribers as of July 2026, and was named after the amount he loved his wife.<ref name=":0" /> On the channel he helps students prepare for [[NCEA (New Zealand)|NCEA]] exams by running [[live streams]] the nights before the exams are run,<ref>{{Cite news |date=11 September 2023 |title=New Zealand internet sensation Subash Chandar helps 33,000 students with NCEA maths |url=https://www.stuff.co.nz/nz-news/350478424/new-zealand-internet-sensation-subash-chandar-helps-33-000-students-with-ncea-maths |access-date=21 March 2025 |work=[[Newshub]] |publisher=[[Stuff (website)|Stuff]]}}</ref> and makes videos which explain how to use equations and calculators.<ref name=":1">{{Cite news |date=30 January 2025 |title=Kiwi teacher finalist in million dollar teaching prize |url=https://www.stuff.co.nz/nz-news/360564063/kiwi-teacher-finalist-million-dollar-teaching-prize |access-date=21 March 2025 |work=[[Stuff (website)|Stuff]]}}</ref> The channel was started in 2013<ref name=":2" /> because Chander K noticed a lack of maths videos designed for children.<ref>{{Cite news |date=22 February 2019 |title=Auckland mathematics teacher using technology to inspire students wins national teaching award in Wellington |url=https://www.stuff.co.nz/national/education/110694934/auckland-mathematics-teacher-using-technology-to-inspire-students-wins-national-teaching-award-in-wellington |access-date=21 March 2025 |work=[[Stuff (website)|Stuff]]}}</ref> His first live stream was in 2018.<ref name=":2" /> 

In 2018 Chandar K won the National Excellence in Education Awards top honour. In January 2025 Chandar K became one of the 10 finalists of the [[Global Teacher Prize]]. Chandar K said that after he discovered the award in 2017, he began working towards it.<ref name=":1" /> In March 2025 Chandar K was awarded the Local Hero of the Year award at the [[New Zealander of the Year Awards]].<ref name=":0" />
